source.document: Mercedes-Benz service information via Xentry — trigger language reproduced from MB service info as documented in Opus ADAS Map inspection report (2021 GLC 300 4MATIC). Additional reference: MBUSA Certified Collision Program Position Statement.

general_requirements: Per MBUSA position statement: vehicles involved in a collision repair should have these systems evaluated. Pre-repair scanning is highly recommended; post-repair scanning is necessary. Many safety and driver-assist systems may have been activated during a collision and require calibration, normalization, or coding.
notes_for_other_components: Trigger lists for Multifunction Camera, Blind Spot Assist, 360° Camera, PARKTRONIC, and other MB ADAS components to be added from Xentry service information. The MBUSA Certified Collision Program Position Statement requires scanning and calibration but does not contain component-level trigger tables — those live in Xentry.
